sources.title: AMAImedia/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-NVFP4-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is a native multimodal mixture-of-experts model for coding, agentic workflows, computer use, and cybersecurity. It supports text, image, and video inputs with a context window of up to 1M tokens.

sources.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Price, Benchmarks, Hugging Face & Access
sources.snippet: Its API name is MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, and it costs $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 per million output tokens, with no extra charge for long prompts. The model first shipped on September 27, 2026 as M3.1-Flash-Preview, a subscription-only test release inside MiniMax Code. The full release replaces that preview.

sources.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Redefining Agent Performance and Cost
sources.snippet: Today, we officially roll out MiniMax M3.1 Flash. As a next-generation Flash model, M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use and cybersecurity, while making online inference nearly three times faster and reducing usage costs by 70%.

sources.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on Blackbox
sources.snippet: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is MiniMax's multimodal M-series model for agent reasoning, tool use, coding, and long-context tasks. Fireworks serves the final weights with hybrid MXFP8 and NVFP4 expert precision, text and image inputs, structured outputs, and implicit prompt caching.
